checks.title: Declared modalities resolve to points
checks.detail: 43 of 45 declared modalities resolve to points with a series; 2 resolve to none (water_flow_chilled, water_flow_hot)
checks.remedy: Add sensors of the unresolved classes to the ontology, or remove them from the declared modality set — a modality nothing measures is a question class that must decline rather than guess.

checks.title: Timeseries references are not duplicated
checks.detail: 1.007 references per series id (3642 references / 3615 ids)
checks.remedy: Back up, prove the loss is zero with a subject-level diff, drop the graph and re-upload — a duplicated graph makes every count meaningless.

checks.title: Each point resolves to exactly one series
checks.detail: every point with a reference resolves to exactly one series id

checks.title: Every store the graph names is registered in both files
checks.detail: 20 store(s) named by ref:storedAt; all registered in both files
checks.remedy: Add the store key to building.yaml storage.databases AND to database_registry.yaml. Named in only one, the wrong adapter is built and every reading for that store fails in a way that looks like missing data.

checks.title: Every registered store answers a query
checks.remedy: A store that does not answer makes every question about its points decline. Check credentials, network reach and the table name.

checks.title: Modelled points carry a series reference
checks.detail: 3489 of 3512 modelled points (99.3%) carry a series reference; 23 are modelled but unreadable
checks.remedy: A point with no ref:hasTimeseriesId is a sensor the building believes it has and cannot read. Link it or remove it.

checks.title: Points reported within 24 h
checks.detail: 43 of 43 measurable quantities reported in the last 24 h; 3489 of 3489 readable points (100.0%)
checks.remedy: A modality with history but no recent rows answers historical questions correctly and must decline present-tense ones. Restore the feed, or accept that 'right now' is out of scope for it.

checks.title: Floors, spaces and rooms resolve
checks.detail: 8 floor(s), 234 space(s), 225 of them placed on a floor; 8 floor(s) carry at least one point
checks.remedy: A space with no floor cannot be reached by a floor-scoped question, and a floor with no points cannot be compared with one that has them.

checks.title: Floor-plan manifests link to graph IRIs
checks.detail: 6 manifest(s), 235 of 354 plan spaces carry an IRI in this building's namespace (66%); 235 of those resolve to a space the graph holds
checks.remedy: Link each plan space to its ontology IRI. An unlinked space has geometry nothing can join to a sensor, which looks like an answerable room and is not.

capabilities.title: Current reading for a named space
capabilities.reason: all 43 measurable quantities reported in the last 24 h across 3489 points.
capabilities.required_data: points with ref:hasTimeseriesId + ref:storedAt, and recent rows in that store

capabilities.title: Whole-building ranking
capabilities.reason: 43 quantities with recent readings cover up to 234 of 234 spaces.

capabilities.title: Per-floor ranking and floor comparison
capabilities.required_data: points placed on at least two floors, with recent readings

capabilities.title: Register / record lookup
capabilities.reason: this building holds 2421 records across 41 of 42 declared classes; a question about the other 1 must be declined by name rather than answered from a neighbouring register.
capabilities.required_data: records lifted into the graph as instances of a declared record class

capabilities.title: Answer from the building's own documents
capabilities.reason: 39 documents are available for prose answers.
capabilities.required_data: policies or manuals in the building's documents folder

capabilities.title: Spatial and floor-plan questions
capabilities.reason: 235 of 354 plan spaces link to a graph IRI; the remainder have geometry that no reading can be attached to.
capabilities.required_data: floor-plan manifests whose spaces carry ontology IRIs
capabilities.missing: IRIs for the remaining 119 plan spaces

capabilities.title: Comparison over time
capabilities.reason: the longest history any store holds is 625 days.
capabilities.required_data: enough history in a registered store to cover both periods

capabilities.title: Forecast
capabilities.reason: 625 days of history behind 43 recently reporting quantities.
capabilities.required_data: recent readings plus a history to fit against

capabilities.title: Privacy refusal
capabilities.reason: the lane is registered and this building holds 4 occupancy-class quantities, which is exactly the population a person-level question must be refused about.
capabilities.required_data: nothing — the refusal must hold whatever the building holds

capabilities.title: Honest absence
capabilities.reason: 234 spaces resolve by name and 2 declared quantities have no readings, so both kinds of absence — a referent that does not exist and a quantity nothing measures — can be stated rather than guessed.
capabilities.required_data: nothing — it is the behaviour when data is missing

capabilities.title: Asset status
capabilities.reason: 112 asset-status records are held; an answer must count the declared set rather than the set it happened to retrieve.

capabilities.title: Event history
capabilities.required_data: event records in the graph or an event store
